note_text:
Claude Code agent-definition `tools:` grant semantics. MEASURED 2026-08-01 on Claude Code 2.1.220 (four controlled probes, ledger row #298); points 2, 3, 4 and 6 refreshed 2026-11-09 against 2.1.319 docs and changelog.

(1) Three definition shapes, three behaviours:
- `tools: *` or unrestricted: full deferred pool, MCP present.
- EXCLUSION list (built-ins Explore and Plan): full deferred pool, ToolSearch works.
- ALLOWLIST: exactly the named tools. With no `mcp__` entry, ToolSearch searches an empty pool.

(2) Literal fully-qualified MCP names in an allowlist DO grant. Measured present and IMMEDIATELY CALLABLE with no ToolSearch step, on sonnet and on opus. ⚠ CONTRADICTED by sibling memory 2ced79ac, recorded the same day from five probes, which says allowlisted MCP tools arrive DEFERRED and need a ToolSearch load. The docs are silent; unresolved until re-probed. 2.1.295 fixed teammates failing their first SendMessage until tool search had loaded.

(3) The bare `mcp__*` wildcard was accepted without error and granted NOTHING (2.1.220).
- UPDATE: the server-level form `mcp__<server>__*` is documented for `tools:` (sub-agents doc, e.g. `mcp__github__*`).
- The wildcard syntax dates from 2.0.70. 2.1.299 narrowed `tools:` matching to the named server: write the server's whole normalized name, including any `__`.
- Bare `mcp__*` is undocumented for `tools:` and has not been re-measured.
- lore's server is named `lore_<slug>` per project, so even a server wildcard is project-specific.

(4) LISTED ≠ POSSESSED. Grep and Glob were listed and not delivered.
- Per tools-reference ("Glob tool behavior"), Claude Code leaves them out of the default tool set on macOS, Linux and WSL.
- A subagent that lists them in `tools:` and leaves out Bash receives them. Not re-measured. Only execution certifies a grant.

(5) Failed-call taxonomy. Read the WHOLE error string; all three classes start `No such tool available: X`:
- nothing more: never enrolled;
- "exists but is not enabled in this context": withheld by grant;
- "not available in this session — <workaround>": disabled session-wide.

(6) Measured 2026-08-01: subagents got a FRESH MCP binding at spawn, so a lead whose session bound while a server was down could still spawn agents that reached it.
- ⚠ CONTESTED: the sub-agents doc says subagents inherit the main conversation's MCP tools, and string `mcpServers` references "share the parent session's connection".
- 2.1.311 fixed subagents being unable to use servers that finish connecting after the subagent starts.
- The 2026-08-01 observation predates that fix. Re-probe before relying on it either way.

FIX (landed and verified 2026-08-01, still in place): the seven lore-facing definitions (tdd family ×5, contract-adversary, package-scout) deliberately carry NO `tools:` key (commits 4729fb5 and 7ee7c74; 7/7 live lore_comms registrations). Do not re-add an allowlist without re-running the spawn probes.

Receipts: docs/plans/v2/receipts/2026-08-01-agent-comms-fix/; findings #298, #294, #299.
